assessment: This paper describes a new method to investigate Staphylococcus aureus intracellular virulence that has produced important insights into the mechanisms of staphylococcal pathogenesis. The results are convincing and the methodology is state-of-the-art. The authors have responded to the reviewer comments and resolved the issues identified during the review. This paper will be of interest to scientists studying microbial intracellular pathogenesis and cell biology.
